description: Pre-flop opening ranges (conservative range from each chart), transcribed from handwritten notes and the four range charts.
notation: Standard range shorthand. '66+' = that pair and every higher pair. 'ATs+' = suited, kicker T or higher up to one below the top card (ATs, AJs, AQs, AKs). 'AJo+' = same but offsuit. No '+' = that exact hand only.

positions.name: Under the Gun
transcriptionNotes: JTs is shaded dark (conservative) on the chart but is not in the handwritten notes. Included here because 9.8% only works out with it.
